property_summary: For any admissible call to transfer (non-empty recipient/value arrays, with from, caddress passed to a recording helper), the reference always makes each low-level call carrying calldata whose decoded first argument equals the caller-supplied `from` (i.e., the callee sees the original sender), whereas the mutant forwards `from` as the recipient argument of transfer(address,uint256), so the recorded `from` argument differs when from is not the recipient.
change_summary: Change the low-level call selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,uint256).
